author: GH-Jaider

brief.en: Five beepers lie ahead, one per corner. Collect every one of them and stop at the far wall.
brief.es: Hay cinco zumbadores por delante, uno por esquina. Recógelos todos y párate junto al muro del fondo.

solution:
BEGINNING-OF-PROGRAM
    BEGINNING-OF-EXECUTION
        WHILE front-is-clear DO
        BEGIN
            move;
            IF next-to-a-beeper THEN
                pickbeeper
        END
        turnoff
    END-OF-EXECUTION
END-OF-PROGRAM
